self_digest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

selection.description: Rank synthetic/meta.csv rows by SHA-256(UTF8(seed) || 0x00 || compact canonical JSON([fileid])), sort by (rank, identity), take 32, and bind all four LFS WAVs per selected row.

limitations.target_scaling: Multiply each case's nearend_speech signal by that case's metadata.nearend_scale before target-scale comparisons.
limitations.erle_db: Report only on separately pinned far-end-single-talk intervals; this lock provides no interval annotations.
limitations.aecmos: Requires a separately pinned compatible scorer and model; neither is evidence-bound by this lock.
limitations.near_end_attenuation_db: Requires the scaled clean near-end target and a separately pinned alignment, activity-mask, and scoring protocol.
limitations.barge_metrics: Require a separately pinned deterministic speech-onset, decision, and latency protocol; this corpus provides no command transcript or barge-event labels.
limitations.evidence_scope: A passing replay is offline fixture evidence only, not live microphone, loudspeaker, room, route, wall-clock latency, or device-generalization evidence.
